name: Session-cardinality chaff amplification of HITL review
description: Attacker rotates fresh session identities so that session-keyed deduplication and per-session quotas treat each low-severity event as a new bucket, multiplying human-in-the-loop review prompts until review capacity is exhausted.
regex: (?is)^(?!.*\b(?:unit test|test fixture|scanner rule|security training|incident report|postmortem|blocked payload|must not|do not|never|safe handling|defensive)\b)(?=.*\b(?:low[- ]severity|low priority|informational)\b)(?=.*\b(?:audit(?:able)? event|review event|HITL|human[- ]in[- ]the[- ]loop|approval prompt)\b)(?=.*\b(?:many|numerous|excessive|flood|spam|burst|thousands|repeated)\b)(?=.*\b(?:fresh|unique|new|rotating|attacker[- ]chosen)\s+(?:session(?:[_ -]?id)?|identit(?:y|ies)|contexts?)\b)(?=.*\b(?:per[- ]session|session[- ]keyed|session_id|dedup(?:lication)?|quota|budget)\b)(?=.*\b(?:multiply|amplif|exhaust|overwhelm|waste|starv|deplete|review capacity|review queue)\b).*$
